inputs.text: Taoiseach Micheál Martin said in Limerick this past week that housing tenancies have increased, despite concerns about rising eviction notices and homelessness following new Government rules introduced on March 1 requiring landlords to provide tenants with six-year leases. The number of people in emergency accommodation nationally increased again.
